pages.text: $(bold)A base on another planet is a major infrastructure project.$()$(br2)You need breathable air, power and supplies. Your T2-T4 tech pays off here: if you built proper RF infrastructure, colonizing space is much easier.

$(bold)Oxygen Distribution$()$(br)The $(bold)Oxygen Distributor$() makes the space around it breathable. It scales with area and needs $(italic)significant$() RF power. One distributor covers a small room, so a proper base needs several.$(br2)$(bold)Water Pump$()$(br)Pumps up water to turn into oxygen. Place it near ice deposits on Mars, or bring water tanks.

$(bold)RF Power on Planets$()$(br)Ad Astra's built-in Coal Generator is weak on purpose. You $(italic)must$() bring real power infrastructure:$(br)• $(bold)Mekanism Generators$(): Fusion Reactor, Gas-Burning Generator$(br)• $(bold)Thermal Dynamos$(): portable and reliable$(br)• $(bold)Flux Networks$(): the mod for moving RF across dimensions$(br2)A Fusion Reactor powering a Moon base feels earned. A Coal Generator does not.

$(bold)Flux Networks: Your Best Friend$()$(br)Flux Networks is the $(italic)only$() way to send RF wirelessly across dimensions, so a player who set it up during T2-T3 starts space exploration far ahead.$(br2)Put a Flux Controller at your Overworld base and Flux Points on each planet for instant wireless power: the intended way to run a planetary base.$(br2)$(bold)Next: a Flux Controller at home.$()
